rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`. The requirement lets a skill link to files for specialized material, but each such link must say when to read the file. The file has three markdown links to other files, and each one says when:
- `[CI example](references/ci.md)` is introduced by "Use the CI example ... when adding these steps to an existing workflow".
- `[references/distributed-requirements.md](...)` is introduced by "read ... before drafting it, and whenever you edit a `{req}` that contains `{sites}` or `{violations}`".
- `[references/syntax-details.md](...)` is introduced by "If a file that implements or tests a requirement cannot carry a comment ... or a requirement lives in a nested chapter, read ...".

The mention of the habeas-evidence skill's `references/fixme.md` is plain code text, not a link. It also gives a context: "`{fixme}` acknowledges a deferred gap". No violation matches were listed. The site meets the requirement.

text: A bundled skill MAY put material needed only in specialized situations in files it links to. Each such link MUST say when to read the file. Each bundled skill, recognized by its front matter, is a site:
